_comment: EXAMPLE registry for hooks/protected_board_guard.py (gate 5b). Copy to knowledge/protected_boards.json and list each GitHub Projects board that agents must never add items to. Each entry needs at least "owner" and "number"; "node_id" (the board's PVT_... id), "title", "tracker" and "reason" make matching and the deny message more precise. With an empty list nothing is protected, and the guard allows every gh project command.
